purpose: Teach the learner to reconstruct and use dependency DAGs, critical path/span, parallel scheduling, CPM/PERT, fork-join/series-parallel structure, work-span reasoning, and DAG shortest paths without installing a sovereign host scheduler.

teaching_cases.train_shape: bounded synthetic obligations with opaque labels, explicit returned prerequisite facts, independent branches, resource conflicts, uncertain durations, a fork, a join, one high-work noncritical branch, and one tempting inadmissible shortcut
held_out: opaque relabeling and shuffled presentation order
duration perturbation that moves the critical path
noncritical duration perturbation that leaves completion unchanged

required_outputs: shortest lawful path under declared cost
b1: structure survives opaque relabeling/order changes and distinguishes dependency from adjacency
b2: interventions on dependency/duration/admissibility change scheduling consequences in the correct direction
b3: WITHHOLD until later learner-owned developmental scheduling succeeds after teacher dependency labels/scaffold are unavailable
